pages: Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, stands at the service room door with one fingertip on an engraved data plate. Middle distance: a padlocked door, a handrail, a coil of rope on the step. Background: the causeway, wet basalt, low sun.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, leans toward the burner with one hand beside a single white glowing mantle inside its brass frame. Middle distance: rings of ground glass, a fuel can, a wick key. Background: lantern glazing, black night sea.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, stands on the catwalk under the optic with one hand on a brass toothed change wheel. Middle distance: a cast drive bed, wire rope, a hanging hand torch. Background: the tower stair, burner glare above.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, holds one open brass stopwatch in his palm and watches the lens turn. Middle distance: a log book on the rail, a hand torch, burner glow behind the glass. Background: the beam going out over black water.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, stands on the stair landing with one log book in both hands, head turned to the stair above. Middle distance: the iron steps, a handrail, a tin mug on a ledge. Background: the lantern doorway, warm lamplight.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, stands with both hands on the catwalk rail, watching one bright bull's-eye come round and hesitate. Middle distance: the lens rings, a hanging torch, the burner glow. Background: glazing bars, the night horizon.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, kneels with one palm flat on the cast drive bed, feeling for a pulse. Middle distance: a radiotelephone set on the ledge, a spanner, an oily rag. Background: the weight wire rising into the dark.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, stands at the head of the iron steps, one hand on the wet handrail, listening down the stair. Middle distance: a coil of rope, a landing stage, a tin pail. Background: the causeway under water, grey morning.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, sits on the edge of the landing stage at Port Waikato with one sheet of a letter in both hands. Middle distance: grocery crates, a tractor wheel, an anchor stock. Background: harbour water, mudflats, low sun.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, crouches beside the optic with one brass hand lamp at the narrow inspection slot. Middle distance: the lens carriage, a screwdriver, a folded cloth. Background: the rings above, the beam going out to sea.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, crouches at the trough and sights along the brass frame, one hand on the gunmetal rim. Middle distance: a screwdriver, a cloth, the burner pipe. Background: the tower wall, one dim yellow lamp.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, kneels under the gearbox holding one small fibre-washered drain plug, oil on his fingertips. Middle distance: the gearbox case, a pressed steel tray, a spanner. Background: cast iron, wire rope, lamplight on rust.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, lowers one galvanised covered drum on a rope into the trough, both hands on the rope. Middle distance: a strip of stiff paper, a jug, the optic rim. Background: the lantern room, the beam beyond the glass.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, holds one strip of newspaper flat on the quicksilver, lifting the grey skin off in one piece. Middle distance: a covered drum, a small jug, the trough rim. Background: burner flame and glass rings, warm light.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, kneels and slides one galvanised paint tin under the gearbox to catch the drip. Middle distance: an open log book on a ledge, a spanner, a bracket. Background: the tower ironwork, one hanging lamp.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, holds his face close to the upper lens glass, one fingertip raised towards a long scratch following a ring. Middle distance: a chalk block, a cloth, the lit mantles. Background: glazing bars, the bright rings behind.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, sits on the catwalk with one log book open at its back pages, a pencil making a sum. Middle distance: a card, a tin of graphite, the burner glow. Background: the glass rings above, the dark tower.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, stands on the catwalk with one hand on the rail, looking at the turning optic. Middle distance: a hanging lantern, the weight wire, the burner pipe. Background: the night horizon, a beam sweeping over black water.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, writes on one small folded card at the tool store bench. Middle distance: a tin of graphite, brass drift pins, the open log. Background: the tower wall, one bare lamp, iron steps.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, stands on the gravel causeway with one storm lantern in his hand, looking back at the tower. Middle distance: wet gravel, the last iron steps, a mooring ring. Background: the white tower above, the making tide.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, holds one brass thermometer against the lens frame in the cold dawn light. Middle distance: the burner and its wicks, a strip of paper, the trough. Background: the glazing, a pale sunrise over the water.

Hemi, a Maori boy of seventeen, short black hair, a navy wool jersey over a grey work shirt, sleeves pushed up, rubber boots, wades down the causeway with one clothbound log book under his arm, the sea breaking white behind. Middle distance: wet gravel, a marker post, the landing stage. Background: the light still going over his shoulder.
